(ta)༄༅/ /gnod sbyin lcam sring gi rjes gnang gi lag len khrig chags su bkod pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang dpal pad+ma dbang chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// gnod sbyin lcam sring gi rjes gnang gi lag len khrig chags su bkod pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang dpal pad+ma dbang chen la phyag 'tshal lo// chos srung lcam sring gi rjes gnang byed tshul sgrub mchod dang 'brel na rta mgrin gyis las gzhung bsrang zhing*/ 'dzab bstod tshar ba'i rjes su'am/ ma 'brel na gnas dben par yi dam gyi gtor ma snying gzugs can mtheb kyus bskor ba rgyan ldan dang*/ yang snod gcig tu lcam sring gi gtor ma zur gsum che ba gcig gi g.yon du zur gsum chung ba gcig bslan la cig shos las rtse cung zad dma' ba/ gnyis ka'i tha ma mtheb kyus bskor ba rgyan ldan mda' dar dmar po btsugs/ yod na lcam sring gi tsa ka li yang btsugs/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga/ chos skyong la 'bul gtor zur gsum chung ngu gnyis kyang bsham/ de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma lhar bskyed pa'i skabs su 'byung ba'i dpal pad+ma dbang chen yab yum gyi mngon rtogs dang*/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kro dhe shwa ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa'i bar byas la/ mdun gyi yi dam gtor ma la dmigs te bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dbang chen 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ma hā pad+me shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ ma hā pad+me shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā his nang mchod 'bul/ rgyal ba kun bdag chos sku pad+ma'i gsung*// chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos// spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas dbang chen sku// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal pad+ma dbang chen gyi lha tshogs rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/

bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ de nas chos skyong gi gtor ma la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las yi dam gyi mdun ngos kyi 'og phyogs su rta khrag dang mi khrag gi rgya mtsho dmar la dwangs pa rba klong gru gsum bsnol mar 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rta ro dang mi ro brtsegs pa'i steng du/ pram̐ dang zangs kyi ral gri las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg rtse can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar bas dam nyams kyi srog rtsa gcod par byed pa/ g.yon mda' gzhu dang bcas pa'i dgra bgegs kyi glo snying thugs kar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung g.yon du bse'i ru mtshon dmar po 'phyar ba/ sku la zangs kyi beg rtse dang*/ dar gyi ral gu dmar pos brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis sag ti'i l+h+wam 'bob gsol zhing*/ brkyang bskum 'dor thabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i g.yon du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ mam̐ las rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma sku mdog sngo nag gdong pa bse/ so dung*/ smin ma g.yu/ me'i ral pa la mchong dang mu men gyis brgyan pa/ gser gyi rna rgyan can/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi ral gri dgra la 'phyar ba/ g.yon gnam lcags kyi phur bu zur gsum pa bgegs la 'debs pa/ dred mo nag mo mi zan la zhon nas stong gsum skad cig la nyul ba/ lcam sring de gnyis kyi bka' 'khor du bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ byang shar dbang ldan ma ru tse'i dur khrod nas gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

kyai yul gcig mya ngam 'das bdun pha rol na// mda' na khrag mtsho phu na zangs brag ri// bse mkhar smug po dung gi ba gam can// thod skam brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas chen po nas// chos skyong dregs pa lcam sring gshegs su gsol// rak+mo prā ṇa āt+ma sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rak+mo prā ṇa āt+ma sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob chos sgrub 'khor bcas kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ rak+mo prā ṇa āt+ma sa pa ri wā ra sarba bigh+nān sha trūm̐ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ rak+mo prā ṇa āt+ma k+ṣe ru pu ru ṣa lo hi ha sarba sha trūm̐ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rak+mo ya ma tsit+ta dz+wa la raṃ/ pra ti de wī hūm̐/ srog la ya ma dza/ sarba sha trūm̐ mā ra ya rbad phaṭa/ lan gsum mam lnga bzlas/ oṃ rak+mo prā ṇa āt+ma sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nang mchod dngos su phul ba'am stangs ka byed/ kyai dmar chen gyi gtor ma ro brgya dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' sdod/ ma hā de wa'i bka' nyan/ rgya gar yul gyi dgra lha/ ma ru tse'i gnas srung*/ li yul chos kyi srung ma/ bod yul ma mo'i stong dpon/ yab gnod sbyin zangs kyi ral pa can dang*/ yum srin mo khrag gi ral pa can gyi sras gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg rtse can/

sring mo srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul ba yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob chos sgrub pa 'khor bcas la sdang zhing mtho 'tshams pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa dang*/ mthun rkyen bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun pa'i yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ de nas slob ma khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du chos skyong lcam sring gi rjes gnang gsan snyam pa bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la gnod sbyin chen po beg gdong lcam sring 'di ni/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba la grags pa'i pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i chos skor bsam/ dbang chen thugs gsung sku'i sprul pa gza' beg gying gsum gyi rnam bzhag 'byung ba las/ rta mgrin gyi gsung gi sprul par bshad pas ngo bo ye shes pa yin la/ drang don du gtam rgyud khungs ma rnams nas/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la rgyal po zhig la sras gnyis yod pa'i che ba grags ldan ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa yin pas byang chub kyi spyod pa la thugs gzhol/ chung ba grags skyes ni shin tu gtum zhing gsod gcod kho na la dga' bas gcen gyis byang chub tu sems bskyed du bcug kyang ma nyan par/ mthar srin po lta bur gyur tshe slar yang gcen gyis bka' bsgos phas ma 'ongs pa na khyod kyi bstan pa la gnod sbyin mthu rtsal can cig tu skyes nas bstan pa srung bar smon lam btab/ gcen gyis kyang chas dang phyag mtshan gyis mthu stobs dang ldan par dbang bskur/ shāka thub 'jig rten du 'byon pa tsam gyi dus su 'dzam bu gling gi byang shar dur khrod ma ru tse zhes pa 'jigs shing ya nga ba'i gnas der/

gnod sbyin zangs kyi ral pa can dang*/ srin mo khrag gi ral pa can gnyis bshos pa las zangs kyi sgo nga gcig dang*/ mchong gi sgo nga gcig skyes/ sgo nga de gnyis nam mkha' sa 'og sa steng thams cad du 'phur zhing 'grims pa lha klu gza' skar phyogs skyong thams cad dbang du bsdus shing bran du bkol/ re zhig na de gnyis brdol ba'i nang nas lcam sring gnyis po 'di byung ngo*// lha chen yab yum gyis dam la btags shing bstan pa srung bar bskos/ slar yang dpal gshin rje gshed dang*/ rta mgrin gyis sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ dam la bzhag ste srog snying bzhes so// de nas sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang mjal te bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams srung zhing skyong bar khas blangs so// bod yul 'dir bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis gter kha du mar 'di'i sgrub skor rnams sbas pa nyang gnubs sogs kyis spyan drangs pa rnams rim bzhin grub thob chen po 'dar phya ru ba rin chen bzang po la bka' babs/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po gnyan dar ma grags kyis gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brtsigs bzhed kyis rgya gar nas bstan srung mang po spyan drangs pa'i ya gyal zhig yin la/ lcam sring 'di dang gnod sbyin shu kra nag po gnyis la dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i las mkhan shan pa dmar nag ces mnga' gsol ba'i dmar po lcam sring gi rjes gnang gdams pa'i skor rnams gnyan lo nas/ gnam kha'u pa/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ sa shud bu bkra shis 'od zer rnams brgyud de grub thob 'dar phyar la bka' babs/ grub thob chen pos li yul lcang ra smug bo nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i phyag bzo bse las grub pa'i lcam sring gi 'chams sku rdzu 'phrul gyis gdan drangs te brag ram gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol/

chos skyong bka' gnyan cing mthu rtsal che bar rgyal khams thams cad du grags/ 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyi dngos slob bo dong rin chen brtson 'grus rdo rje dang*/ kun mkhyen mus srad pa dpal ldan seng ge dang*/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang*/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa rin po che sogs mkhas grub chen po rnams kyis srung ma dam tshig can khyad par du 'phags par bsngags shing bsten pas phrin las thams cad thogs med du bsgrubs/ grub thob 'dar phyar nas bka' gter gnyis ka phyogs gcig tu 'dril ba'i man ngag lag len ma nub par bzhugs pa las/ thog mar sgrub pa po chos skyong dang ngo sprod par byed pa'am/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi phrin las la dbang bar byed pa rjes gnang gi rim pa la/ lcam sring gnyis dang*/ 'khor mang gi rjes su gnang ba'i bka' srol gnyis las/ 'dir lcam sring gi rjes gnang sgrub par byed pa la slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug gang gi drin gyis nas/ rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// bdag la chos skyong lcam sring gi// rjes su gnang ba mdzad du gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ rjes gnang gi gzhi lus bsgrub pa'i slad du thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das dpal pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la phog tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po 'di yang 'od gsal gyi ngang du gtsang sing sbyangs te/ sku lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/

phung khams skye mched la sogs pa snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ci yang mi dmigs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur/ stong nyid de ka'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma ru tra pho mo mnan pa'i steng du/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das dpal pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang*/ dbus dmar nag spyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu/ rngog ma dmar po phrum phrum ser po/ zhur dkar po rta skad 'tsher bzhin pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra ser po/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag dang po pad+ma dang ban+dha/ bar pa gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis be con dang ral gri/ sku la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang*/ glang chen gyi ko rlon gsol ba/ sku smad la stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ tshal bu'i dpung rgyan/ thod rlon lnga bcu tshar gyi do shal/ sbrul rigs bzhi dang rin po ches sku la brgyan pa/ zhag gi zo ris/ rak+ta'i thig le/ thal chen gyi tshom bu can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i gshog pa can/ zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu lta ba/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ral pa nag po mun pa ltar gtibs pa/ phyag g.yas tsit+ta thogs nas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yon dung chen dmar 'khyil gtso bo la stob pa'i sku can rer gsal lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa gnang bar zhu/ mdun gyi gtor ma dang gnyis su med pa'i chos skyong lcam srid sngar yod gsal btab pa'i tshul gyis bskyed pa yin te/ de yang mdun gyi gnas 'di nyid du rta khrag dang mi khrag gi rgya mtsho dmar la dwangs ba zhes pa nas/

bka' nyan dam can rgya mtshos bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i thugs mos gnang ba dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig dang rten 'brel gyi dbang gis don la yang bzhugs nges shes pa yin zhes brda sprad/ slob dpon dpal pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi chos skyong lcam sring la phog thugs rgyud bskul bas mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du chos skyong lcam sring gi sku re chad nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ gu gul gyi dud pa dang rol chen byas la lcam sring gi srog sngags brjod/ yang thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon dpal pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi lcam sring gi thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul thugs ka'i srog sngags gnyis pa chad/ khyed rang rnams dpal pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i snying gar bstims tshar ba'i chos skyong lcam sring gi thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ spos rol bya zhing srog sngags brjod/ de nas rak+mo pra ṇa āt+ma zhes sogs srog sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum dang*/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing*/ chos skyong bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyis dril bu gsil/ slob ma la me tog 'thor zhing*/ chos skyong 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// ces brjod/ de nas gnod sbyin gtor ma slob ma pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i lag tu bzhag la/ dpal pad+ma dbang chen/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dpal ldan grub thob 'dar 'phyar/

bo dong pa brtson 'grus rdo rje/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang po/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge la sogs pa nas bzung ste/ brag ram bka' bzhi chen mo/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug drin chen bsod nams chos 'phel gyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rdo rje slob ma 'di la byang chub ma thob bar du srung skyobs gsum mdzad pa dang*/ 'di yi bran g.yog bka' sdod gyis la ci bcol ba'i las rnams sgrubs/ zhes brjod la gtor ma sngar gyi stegs kyi steng du bzhag yang slob dpon gyis lcam sring gi srog sngags tshar gcig brjod pa des rkyen byas/ mdun gyi lcam sring 'khor bcas rnams dgra bgegs la rngams zhing khros par gyur te/ sprul pa yang sprul du ma chad nas 'jig rten gyi khams gang*/ sgrub pa po chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad par byas nas tshur 'dus khyed rang rnams dpal chen por gsal ba'i snying gar bzhugs pa'i chos skyong lcam sring gi thugs kar thim pa'i mos pa mdzod ces pa'am/ spros pa la dga' na 'dir yang gu gul gyi dud pa dang rol chen bya zhing srog sngags brjod/ rjes gtso bos ji ltar dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs 'dra/ de nas thun gtor 'bul zhing*/ kyai dpal ldan ma ru tse yi dur khrod nas// mchong dmar brag la brten pa'i gnas bcas pa// zhes sogs spyi bstab dang*/ yig brgya/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten la brtan bzhugs/ dge ba bsngo ba/ bkra shis kyi phreng bas mtha' brtan par bya'o// zhes pa 'di grub thob kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rje btsun rdo rje 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyi bka' 'bangs dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis rje bla ma las rjes gnang dus kyi yig rnying dang*/ phyag bzhes ji ltar mdzad pa la gzhi brten nas rang dang skal ba mnyam pa rnams la phan pa'i don du sa mo lug lo dbyar dus zla ba drug pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin bul rong dben pa'i ri khrod du legs par sbyar ba'o// rang gi brgyud pa'i lugs mchog gtsor bzung nas// bstan dang bstan 'dzin kun la'ang phyogs 'dzin gyi// dri mas ma sbags dag snang sgar sgrub brtson// gzur gnas skyes bu de la chos skyong 'go

/zhes kyang smras so// 'dis kyang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// //'di'i rjes gnang gi lo rgyus bshad pa rje ngag dbang legs grub kyi 'khor mang rjes gnang nas blo gter dbang pos bsabs pa'o// //shu bhaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
